prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `mean_variance(probabilities, values)` in src/lib.rs for a finite discrete distribution. Both slices must be non-empty and the same length; every probability must be finite, non-negative, and sum to 1 within `1e-9`; every value must be finite. Return `Some((mean, variance))` with `variance = sum p_i (v_i - mean)^2`, or `None` for invalid input. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
